create.name: Dougall Fraser
create.bio:
Dougall Fraser is a psychic, author and intuitive coach based in Los Angeles whose particular gift is reading the colours he sees in people's auras. He says he gave his first reading at eight, and from fifteen he studied meditation and energy work on Long Island, including Reiki, qigong and polarity, later studying and teaching at the APLE Foundation School of Light. He has worked professionally for around twenty-five years, was named Dallas's best psychic at twenty, and calls himself, with characteristic humour, the 'Queer Guy with a Third Eye'.

His approach mixes clairvoyance and empathy with colour, practical advice and an insistence that everyone has intuitive ability of their own. He offers 45-minute intuitive video sessions that begin with the colours in a client's aura, and a form of 'cosmic coaching' that pairs intuitive insight with goal-setting over several sessions. He also trains others to coach intuitively and teaches online courses on psychic development and manifesting, with a separate Japanese-language site for students in Japan. His books include But You Knew That Already, Your Life in Color, a guide to using colour energy in daily life, and the Angels & Auras Oracle deck. He works with his husband and manager, David Harel.

books.title: Your Life in Color: Empowering Your Soul with the Energy of Colors
books.author: Dougall Fraser
books.description: A step-by-step plan for working with colour energy, drawing on Dougall's years of reading auras, to bring the qualities of particular colours into everyday life.

books.title: But You Knew That Already: What a Psychic Can Teach You About Life
books.author: Dougall Fraser
books.description: Stories from Dougall's psychic practice, written to show that the insights clients hope a reader will give them are often ones they can reach themselves.

books.title: Angels & Auras Oracle Cards: A 44-Card Deck and Guidebook
books.author: Dougall Fraser
books.description: An oracle deck and guidebook that pairs angelic guidance with the meanings of aura colours, meant for playful self-reflection and readings.

courses.title: Intuitive Video Session
courses.description: A 45-minute reading on Zoom: Dougall begins by describing the colours he sees in your aura and what they suggest, then opens the second half to your own questions.

courses.title: Cosmic Coaching Certification Program
courses.description: A training for people who want to combine intuitive reading, channelling and coaching structure in sessions with others, taught by Dougall online.

free_resources.title: Discover Your True Intuitive Gifts (free guide)
free_resources.description: A free three-step guide from Dougall to recognising which of the 'clairs' you lean towards and how to start using your intuition. Delivered by email.
